description: This file defines several FastAPI API endpoints related to Jira, including fetching accessible resources, projects, project details, and user permissions. It utilizes dependency injection, data validation, and external Jira service calls.

classes.name: JiraProject
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a Jira project with metadata.

classes.name: AccessibleResourcesResponse
classes.description: Response model containing a list of accessible Jira resources.

classes.name: ResourceInfo
classes.description: Model representing information about a Jira resource.

classes.name: JiraProjectsResponse
classes.description: Response model for list of Jira projects with metadata.

classes.name: SessionInfo
classes.description: Model holding session/authentication information for the user.

methods.name: get_accessible_resources( session: SessionInfo = Depends(get_jira_session) )
methods.description: Fetches and returns accessible Jira resources for an OAuth authenticated user.

methods.name: get_jira_projects( cloud_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Cloud ID for OAuth authentication"), session: SessionInfo = Depends(get_jira_session) )
methods.description: Retrieves all Jira projects accessible to the authenticated user, with optional cloud ID.

methods.name: get_jira_project_details( project_key: str, cloud_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Cloud ID for OAuth authentication"), session: SessionInfo = Depends(get_jira_session) )
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific Jira project identified by project key.

methods.name: get_user_permissions( cloud_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Cloud ID for OAuth authentication"), session: SessionInfo = Depends(get_jira_session) )
methods.description: Retrieves user permissions within Jira for the authenticated user.

ctags.signature: ( project_key: str, cloud_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Cloud ID for OAuth authentication"), session: SessionInfo = Depends(get_jira_session) )
